Project Overview

Designed with purpose,
made for everyday life

Learn about the planning, character, and everyday experience created for One Prime Residential.

Give your busy lifestyle the antidote of nature, luxury, relaxation and ease for a blissful living experience. Step inside a space encapsulating the essence of extravagance with world-class specifications at One Prime residential part, an exclusive community hub by Revera Developers LLP. Strategically located at Newtown Action Area 1, find a large selection of commercial facilities just a few steps away from your abode to add the quintessential touch of elegance and convenience to your lifestyle unlike anywhere else.

Frequently Asked Questions

Helpful project information

Answers to common questions about the project, its features, and the next steps.

What type of property is One Prime Residential?+

One Prime Residential is a residential project by Ruchi Realty in New Town, Kolkata. Review the overview, amenities, specifications and plans on this page for full project details.

What is the current status of One Prime Residential?+

One Prime Residential is currently listed as available for enquiry. Contact the project team to confirm the latest construction, possession and inventory status before making a decision.

Is One Prime Residential RERA registered?+

RERA registration and approval details for One Prime Residential, where applicable, can be confirmed with the project team and verified on the relevant official state RERA portal.

How can I check the current price and availability for One Prime Residential?+

Submit the enquiry form on this page to receive the latest price, available units or plots, configurations and applicable offers directly from the One Prime Residential sales team.

Can I schedule a site visit or view plans for One Prime Residential?+

Yes. Use the enquiry option to schedule a site visit. Available floor plans can be viewed on this page. You can also request the project brochure online.
